summary: No blocking source defect found. The new deployment path requires the original two-full50 terminal receiver receipt and remote controller/child absence before starting one fresh-model diagnostic per physical GPU2/3. Each diagnostic consumes 16 training B64/P8K8 batches, evaluates four Smooth-AP temperatures and the weighted first fused CE on the same forward, and requests only feature derivatives using scale512/unscale512 outside autocast. No optimizer or model/array save is called. The prepared terminal text intake and CPU analyzer have no obvious result-integrity blocker. This PASS establishes source readiness only: the original terminal closure receipt was absent during review, so execution remains gated.

evidence: probe_list_training_signal.py builds once, resets observation RNG to43 after initialization, and makes exactly one full-view model call for each of16 consumed training batches. All four temperatures reuse output[1] from that call; there is no separate temperature-dependent model forward.

rgbnt201_identity_outlet.py returns fused as output[1] and computes output[0] as fused_classifier(fused_neck(fused)), preserving the CE-to-feature graph. SharedIdentityAxis.loss_weights starts with1, and run_r201e_list_objective.step replaces the first loss with .25*xent+AP, so the diagnostic .25*xent(output[0],target) matches the weighted primary fused CE component.

The CE is formed under the same forward autocast convention as training. The CE derivative and each AP derivative use autograd.grad(512*loss,feature,retain_graph=True)/512 within disabled autocast. smooth_ap explicitly computes normalized cosine/ranks in FP32. No detach is introduced between loss and feature.

The diagnostic checks finite feature gradients, requires nonzero CE L2 before division, records AP L1/L2/max/nonzero counts and the AP-to-primary-CE norm ratio, and checks every parameter.grad remains None. autograd.grad returns feature derivatives without optimizer updates or accumulation into model parameter.grad.

Disabled autocast during derivative requests does not reconstruct a wholly FP32 forward: CE still differentiates through the saved AMP head operations. This is the intended formal-forward comparison, not a claimed full-FP32 parameter-gradient audit.
list_retrieval_objective.py normalizes the actual FP32 5120-dimensional feature, forms S=FF^T, uses same-training-label positives with i!=k, and requires both positives and negatives per query.

For each query i and candidate k, its competitor mask excludes j=i and j=k. all_rank is1+sum_j sigmoid((S_ij-S_ik)/temperature); positive_rank uses the same competitors restricted to same-label j. Only positive k contribute to AP_i; the objective is1-mean_i(AP_i). Query and gallery roles both remain differentiable.

B64/P8K8 is asserted through64 distinct names,7 positives and56 negatives per row. Training positives are camera-agnostic; this is distinct from the existing official same-ID/same-camera evaluation exclusion and is disclosed in the original objective.

Temperatures are fixed to[.01,.02,.05,.1], AP coefficient1 and the comparison CE coefficient.25. The diagnostic changes no formal loss, temperature, target, model parameter or benchmark-selection rule.

acceptance_limits: SOURCE_ONLY same-family provisional review; actual model/backend/effort are UNATTESTED. No diagnostic runtime success, resource-fit guarantee or closure success is established here.
Do not run the diagnostic or either prepared closeout helper before the actual original closure gate succeeds. The current formal50 sources/checkpoints/receiver remain untouched.

Measurements are derivatives with respect to the returned fused feature at a fresh additional-expert/head state on the original E28 frozen anchor. They are not total parameter gradients, optimizer update magnitudes or mature-checkpoint gradient dominance.

The denominator is the first weighted fused CE only. Auxiliary/base/partial CE, triplets, contribution loss and their parameter-gradient paths are not included; ratios cannot be promoted to full-objective dominance claims.

Scale512 is the explicit fixed diagnostic protocol and matches the initial/first20 formal scale. It does not reproduce any later dynamic GradScaler history. Recorded numeric norm/nonzero statistics should be interpreted within the actual AMP-forward/FP32-loss protocol.

The four temperatures are a bounded training-signal diagnostic on the same16 forwards per control, not benchmark-based temperature selection, a full-training census, proof of loss degeneracy or evidence of retrieval improvement.

The diagnostic is limited to full-modality RGBNT201 training observations and one initialization/observation seed. It establishes no missing49 performance, multi-seed stability, three-dataset +2 result, or original failed-native root cause.
Private training-mode BN state changes are expected and unsaved. They do not constitute learned optimizer updates or modifications of the live formal models.
